verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an official hosted MCP server at https://git.cafe/mcp that AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT can connect to. Its read tools work on public repositories without an account, and with approval it can work on issues and pull requests. WebMCP exposes the same tools to in-browser agents, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting and using the server, and detailed documentation of the account-connection and approval flow.
